name: Gnawing Spite
art: A mud-smeared hand clenched so hard that the nails draw blood from the palm.

name: Mud Brawler
art: A thin sinner waist-deep in black mud raises both fists, ready to swing at anyone.

name: Adimari Bravo
art: A swaggering young Florentine thug in a red hood draws a dagger in a narrow medieval street.

name: Mud-Choked Soul
art: A head barely above a black swamp, mud bubbling from its mouth as it tries to speak.

name: Tearing Teeth
art: Two muddy sinners locked together in the swamp, one biting into the other's shoulder.

name: Stirring the Mud
art: The surface of a black swamp churning and bubbling as hands and heads break through it.

name: Signal Fires
art: Two small fires burning on top of a dark stone tower above a marsh, a third flame far off in the night.

name: Mud Wrestler
art: A broad-shouldered sinner wrestling another in knee-deep mud, his face twisted with fury.

name: Self-Gnawing Shade
art: A hunched shade in the swamp biting its own wrist, eyes burning with rage.

name: Black Guelph Brawler
art: A Florentine soldier in a black tabard lunges with a short sword in a crowded street brawl.

name: Rabble-Rouser
art: A grinning sinner shoves another face-first into the mud while the crowd around them roars.

name: Florentine Hothead
art: A young nobleman with a flushed face draws his sword in the middle of a crowded market.

name: Marsh Warden
art: A heavy, mud-caked figure crouched like a boulder in the swamp, arms folded over its head.

name: Mud-Caked Sinner
art: A sinner sinking into the swamp while a second, smaller shape claws its way out beside him.

name: Scornful Soul
art: A proud traveller in a red cloak glares down from a small boat at a sinner reaching out of the mud.

name: Butting Heads
art: Two brothers frozen together in ice, slamming their foreheads against each other like rams.

name: The Furies' Nails
art: Three wild-haired women with green serpents in their hair clawing at their own robes atop a burning tower.

name: The Boiling Spring
art: A spring of black boiling water spilling down a ravine of grey rock into a dark marsh.

name: Stygian Brute
art: A huge bald sinner covered in black mud stands up in the swamp, roaring.

name: Brawling Shade
art: A shade with a broken nose throws a wild punch at a figure behind him in the mud.

name: Mud Dweller
art: A lumpy figure half made of swamp mud, smaller muddy hands reaching up around it.

name: Rinier Pazzo, the Mad
art: A wild-eyed highwayman on a rearing horse attacks travellers on a forest road.

name: Tower Watchman
art: A grim watchman in a dark cloak standing on a battlement beside a small fire, spear in hand.

name: Erichtho, the Witch
art: A gaunt sorceress in tattered black robes calls a pale shade up from a battlefield by moonlight.

name: The Silver-Shod Horse
art: A proud warhorse with gleaming silver horseshoes rearing on a cobbled Florentine street.

name: The Mob Turns
art: A crowd of muddy sinners swarming over one man in the swamp, dragging him down with their hands.

name: Brawl in the Mud
art: A whole swamp of naked sinners fighting each other, mud and water flying everywhere.

name: Back With the Other Dogs
art: A robed poet shoves a sinner's grasping hands off the side of a small boat, back into the black mud.

name: The Boat Rides Low
art: An old wooden boat sitting low in black water, its prow cutting a deep wake through the swamp.

name: Drowned Knight
art: A knight in a rusted helmet rising from the swamp, mud pouring from his armour, sword raised.

name: Adimari Captain
art: A heavy-set Florentine captain in a fur-trimmed coat, sword at his hip, sneering from a palace doorway.

name: Marsh Champion
art: A towering sinner wading through the swamp, dragging a smaller one by the hair.

name: The Red Towers of Dis
art: The towers of a dark iron city glowing red-hot from within, rising beyond a smoking marsh.

name: Rancorous Shade
art: A shade bursting back up out of black water, gasping, its face twisted with hatred.

name: Geri del Bello
art: A scowling Florentine in torn clothes points an accusing finger from the shadows of a stone bridge.

name: The Muddy Mob
art: A crowd of mud-covered sinners rising together out of a swamp, fists raised.

name: Black Guelph Captain
art: A captain in a black surcoat with a bloody cheek raises his sword, calling his men to the fight.

name: The Eternal Fire
art: A jet of red fire bursting from a glowing iron tower toward a dark sky.

name: Mire Hulk
art: An enormous hulking sinner coated in thick swamp mud, bellowing with rage.

name: The Alberti Brothers
art: Two identical brothers glaring at each other, hands on their daggers, in a cold stone hall.

name: The Wrathful Throng
art: A great surge of naked, mud-covered sinners rising from the swamp in a wave of fists and teeth.

name: Storm Across the Styx
art: A violent storm wind sweeping across a black marsh, tearing up water and mud under a dark sky.

name: Tydeus, the Spiteful
art: A wounded ancient Greek warrior in a bronze helmet snarling over a fallen enemy on a dusty battlefield.

name: The Gate Slams Shut
art: Huge iron gates of a burning city slamming shut, dark winged figures crowding the walls above.

name: Athamas, the Maddened
art: A crowned king with wild, maddened eyes stalking along a rocky shore, arms spread like a hunter's.

name: Colossus of Mud
art: A colossal figure made of black swamp mud rising over the marsh, rage blazing in its eyes.

name: Mud Soul
art: A small mud-covered soul climbing out of a black swamp, fists clenched.

name: Filippo Argenti, the Wrathful (hero portrait)
art: Head and shoulders of a furious Florentine knight with wild dark hair and a mud-streaked beard, teeth bared, black swamp water around his shoulders.

name: Spite (hero power icon)
art: A round bronze medallion with a clenched fist wreathed in small red flames at its centre.
